title: Machine-learning mining uncovers hidden MXenes, including 11 new rare-earth MXenes
summary: Machine-learning-assisted database mining screened 33 previously synthesized but unrecognized MXene candidates. The team synthesized seven multilayer MXenes with a rapid self-propagating high-temperature method and 11 unexplored rare-earth MXenes, with experiments and modeling suggesting semiconducting behavior and diverse magnetic states.
ai_technology: Machine-learning-assisted database mining for MXene candidates
